ET7 Agent Invitation Rewards

Invite friends through the ET7 APK & APP and follow the participation rules below. Visitors searching for ET7 or ET79 can find the invitation rewards and milestone details here.

How to participate
  1. Share your invitation link with a friend.
  2. Your friend registers through your invitation link and enters your invitation code.
  3. Your friend deposits at least ₹200 and meets the required betting turnover.
  4. Once the invitation qualifies, you can claim your reward.
What constitutes a valid user invitation?

For the invitation reward, a user must meet both conditions:

  • Cumulative recharge of ₹200 or more.
  • Total betting amount of ₹600 or more.
Invitation reward redemption
  • For each successful invitation, the inviter receives a total reward of ₹100, automatically credited by the system.
  • The invited friend receives ₹20.
  • Rewards can be used to play games or withdrawn as cash.
  • The stated maximum daily reward is ₹15,000.
  • The site reserves the right to interpret the terms and conditions of this event.
Invitation milestone rewards · ₹6,000 total

Share your invitation link and have your friend register through it. For this milestone event, a valid invited user must recharge at least ₹200 and have a total betting amount exceeding ₹600.
